ModMetaData.name: Project Vigilance - Thermal Integrity & Materials
ModMetaData.author: Darkness2k (CTOUT)
ModMetaData.description: Standalone programmatic post-def material audit enforcing realistic non-combustible flammability across structural metals (Steel, Plasteel, Uranium, Gold, Silver), stone, Odyssey heavy bridges, all-metal machinery, and gravship hull calibration across core, DLC, and modded Defs.
